_inspectorSnowReport.Report:
12/31 5:45AM - Who’s ready to make the last turns of 2025? We’re wrapping up the year on a high note with 58 ways down, all of which received fresh stripes overnight. After some snowmaking and resurfacing, Polar Bear is set to come back online today. For your way up, 12 lifts are set to spin at 8:30am with the possibility of delays due to high forecasted winds. Early access will be available for First Tracks pass holders. 

The park scene is coming to life with a 13-foot ramp Retro Halfpipe open and firing on East Byrnes Side, alongside 5 additional features to keep the laps rolling. Tyrolinne is also open with 6 features ready to ride!

Start up those snow dances because we have some snow rolling in today and continuing into the New Year with 1-2 inches of accumulation possible. Temperatures are ranging from 21-25 at the base and 12-16 up top. It’s still a good idea to hang on to that extra layer and keep your face covered! Colder temperatures sticking around have allowed snowmaking and resurfacing operations to begin and will continue over the next several days as our team works to prepare the mountain for the New Year.

Tonight is shaping up to be the perfect way to welcome the New Year! New Year’s Eve offers something for everyone, from a family buffet dinner in the Base Lodge to a 21+ Wild West themed party at Grizzly’s with live music, a DJ, and firework views. Join us for the Firework Hike to mid-mountain for a one of a kind view of the show. The Torchlight Parade begins at 8:30pm followed by our annual firework show! For the best viewing experience and to make sure you don't miss any of the action, secure your spot in the Main Base Area by 8:30pm. Can’t wait to see you there!

Ski ya out there! 

Safety Tip: Stay on the groomed portion of terrain. Never duck a rope, they are there for a reason.

Holiday week is in full swing with extended dining hours, live music, and special events keeping the Village looking lively. Check out our Holiday Week Dining, Après & Live Music Guide to see what's open, happening, and where the music is at. There’s something for everyone this Holiday week and we couldn’t be more excited to celebrate with you! Click here to check out the upcoming Events Calendar.

Stay and relish the Green Mountains! Stratton Real Estate is here to help with all your real estate needs. Make your sweet escape a reality.

Reliable cars are the name of the game; that is why we trust Oliver Subaru and Ford. Made for all seasons and all families, check out Oliver Ford and Oliver Subaru for year-round reliability.

_inspectorSnowReport.Report:
Happy New Year’s Eve—Eagle Express is expected to open today! Stay tuned to the website and the Ikon Pass app for real-time terrain updates. Temperatures in the upper 30s and lower 40s are forecast for today. Skies will be cloudy as we move into an active pattern for Thursday and into the weekend. All Sunrise terrain is ungroomed, and early-season hazards exist. Due to early-season conditions, there is no beginner terrain accessible from Moonbeam Express. Apex Express and Sunrise terrain should be considered experts only. Our teams are working hard to bring you more terrain, but please do not duck rope lines into closed terrain. Unseen hazards exist, and you will lose your pass for at least 30 days (at all Ikon Pass resorts). Ring in the New Year with us at the New Year’s Eve Torchlight Parade & Fireworks Show! We have lots of fun events to keep you busy before and after the show. Enjoy a delicious lasagna dinner and a free magic show in Last Chance Lodge from 5:00 — 9:00 p.m. After the New Year’s Eve Torchlight Parade & Fireworks Show, head over to The Thirsty Squirrel to grab a nightcap and sing your heart out to some stellar karaoke.

_inspectorSnowReport.Report:
Good Morning Skiers and Riders! This is Eli with your 5 am snow report for Wednesday, December 31st . Remember the easiest way to get up to date information is on the Ikon Pass app or website.  

Our Mid mountain base is 18 inches, the temperature is 32 degrees, with calm winds and clear skies. 

The Summit base is 32 inches, the temperature is 24 degrees, the winds 16 miles per hour from the west/southwest. 

The base temperature is 9 degrees.  

We will be skiing and riding on 19 lifts, 61 runs, and 578 acres on packed powder and machine made snow.  

This New Year’s Eve, ride the gondola to Thunderhead Lodge for Steamboat’s Dress to Impress Masquerade Party with live DJs, dancing, and a Champagne toast at midnight high above the valley. Tickets are required—get yours at steamboat.com/events and ring in the New Year The Steamboat Way. 

Stay in the know with the Ikon Pass App. Find it in the app store on your mobile device and get lift and trail statuses, conditions updates, and more.  

Ski and Ride with Care and we will see you on the mountain!

12/31/25  5:00am Update: 
Good morning and happy New Years Eve from Crystal Mountain! We’re waking up to another warm, beautiful day in the high country, with clear skies and sunshine already lighting up the slopes. Conditions are shaping up to be smooth and spring-like, especially as the day goes on, so expect softer snow and easy cruising by late morning.

Temperatures will be on the warm side today, making it a perfect day to layer light, take your time, and enjoy long laps with friends. Whether you’re carving groomers, soaking in the views from the lift, or meeting up mid-mountain for a few laughs, it’s an ideal way to welcome the new year—good turns, good company, and good vibes all around.

Start early to enjoy the fresh groomers—the cat crew has been crushing it out there. Stay hydrated, and don’t forget the sunscreen. Here’s to ringing in the new year with smiles, sunshine, and shared turns on the hill.

New year turns on golden snow,
Easy lines in morning glow.
Friends and laughter, sun so bright,
Warm-day turns from first to last light. 

Our annual New Years Bash is tomorrow! Close out 2025 with a burst of excitement; no late-night required! Head to Rafters starting at 6:00 p.m. for family-friendly karaoke, live music, and fun contests. At 9:00 p.m., step outside with your mountain community to enjoy vibrant fireworks lighting up the slopes.

NEW: Jumpstart your new year with these deals! Starting January 1st, we're rolling back the pricing on the Anytime and Mid-week 3-day Passes. Ski for as low as $73 a day! No code needed- but hurry, this deal ends on January 11th. Then, on January 6th, we kick off a full month celebration of our founding year, 1962, with $62 now every Tuesday and Thursday through the end of the month. Midweek deals just got a lot sweeter!

Notes for today:
  1. Although early season conditions still exist widespread around the mountain, there are pockets of deeper snow. Read up on Tree Well and Snow Immersion Safety before heading out on the slopes, and please take it easy out there, especially in higher traffic areas. 
  2. Ski & ride with care. We know you’re excited, and we are too. Please ride responsibly and stay in control today as we launch the 2025-2026 Winter Season. Brush up on Mountain Safety and the Responsibility Code!
  3. Obey all mountain closures. Our team is working hard to open terrain as quickly and safely as possible. Closed areas are closed for a reason, so please keep yourself and our team safe by only skiing in open areas.
  4. Book your shuttle today! The Crystal Express Shuttle is free with a reservation, and runs daily through January 4, and continues on weekends and holidays. 
  5. As a reminder, when being added from the parking waitlist, cancellations are still required if you're not planning on making it up. Thank you!
  6. At this time, paid reservations can only be cancelled by emailing SP+ at  CrystalMtnParking@spplus.com with Reservation #, First Name, and Last Name. The Crystal Mountain Contact center cannot process these cancellations.

_inspectorSnowReport.Report:
December 31st, 6:15 AM
Good morning Sugarbush sliders!  An inch of snow fell at mid mountain and above with another 1-3 inches expected to flurry into the new year by tomorrow! The forecast calls for partly sunny skies and more comfortable temps of low 20's at the base and low teens at the summit.  Winds will be out of the West to toss the fresh snow around creating drifts, scours, and side-stashes. Get ready for some firm and fast groomers today, along with variable conditions as fresh snow will top frozen surfaces.  Tonight, look forward to ringing in the new year in style at the Bush-we've got the torchlight parade and fireworks, Snowshoe tour, and music by the Grift just to name a few!

We have over 200 skiable acres served by 11 lifts and 43 open trails, with 33 of those getting a fresh corduroy overnight.  All-natural terrain is closed today in efforts of snow preservation and will be reassessed in the morning.  Today’s a perfect day to explore one (or more!) of our five dining options open at Lincoln Peak today. One of my personal favorites is a fire side snack at Allyn's Lodge! From warm hearty soups to crisp cold beers, we’ve got something for everyone.

Operations are in holiday hours, which means GMX, Super Bravo and Heaven's Gate will get the party started at 8:00 AM. Followed by all other scheduled lifts at 9:00 AM. The Sugarbush Parks crew has assembled a bumping freestyle setup at Mt. Ellen with 15 features and 2 jumps. Plus, Slowpoke and Sugarbear Forest at Lincoln Peak are home to 13 total features, and newly installed side hits! Snowmaking has shifted to Ripcord and Sugar Run. Join us Dec 24th - Jan 1st, for our Holiday Week at Sugarbush, filled with skiing, riding, and festive events for the whole family.  Check out all of our winter events!

All uphill travel routes at both Lincoln Peak and Mt. Ellen are open, check out our uphill travel policy for more info. *Lincoln Peak evening route will stop at the top of Gate House*

Bonjour Tremblant!

There’s no better place to be this New Year’s Eve than on the mountain! Today’s cold, crisp weather is delivering excellent skiing and snowboarding conditions. Whether you’re chasing fresh turns or soaking in the alpine atmosphere, it’s the perfect way to close out the year. Come celebrate with us and make your final runs of the year ones to remember! 

 Some areas of the mountain will open progressively throughout the day as conditions allow, so be sure to check the Snow Conditions page regularly for the latest updates.

3 Snow Parks are open, and 15 designated areas are open for Snowshoeing and Alpine Touring.

 Wishing you a wonderful New Year’s Eve, and we hope to see you on the mountain! 

Mountain safety tip of the week: Be careful when using the ski lifts.
Knowing how to board ski lifts is essential to ensure the safety of all users.
 
Snow fall is recorded daily at 5 a.m from mid-mountain at North Side (550 m / 1,800 ft). This data, based on 24 hours, provides a picture of on-mountain conditions. Actual accumulation may differ from the official report. Be aware of changing conditions. Lifts and trails exist in a mountain environment and may close due to weather, usage and/or special maintenance.
